name: Shwepyi Nann Thanaka Chandon Face Pack 50gm
description:
Thanaka Chandon Face Pack – 50gm
Brand: Shwe Pyi Nann
Country of Origin: Myanmar
Scent: Herbal
Skin Type: All Skin Types

Nurture your skin naturally with the Thanaka Chandon Face Pack, crafted from the traditional beauty ingredient Thanaka. Known for its skin-enhancing properties, this herbal face pack helps maintain a fair, smooth, and soft complexion while protecting your skin from sun damage.

Key Features & Benefits:

Anti-Aging Support: Helps fight skin cell deterioration to slow down the aging process.

Skin Brightening & Softening: Regular use leaves skin fair, smooth, and soft.

Sun Protection: Provides natural protection against sunburn.

Multi-Functional: Can be used as a skin conditioner, cosmetic, and natural remedy to help prevent pimples.

Natural Ingredients: Made from Thanaka bark, root, and leaves, all revered for their skin-loving properties.

How to Use:

Start with a clean face, removing dirt and oil with a gentle cleanser.

Apply a generous layer of the face pack on your face and neck, avoiding the eye area.

Let it dry for 15–20 minutes, allowing the natural ingredients to work.

Rinse off with lukewarm water, gently massaging in circular motions.

Follow up with a moisturizer to lock in hydration.
